title: OpenRoll Rollout
description: OpenRoll v0.1.0 — open standard for recording RL rollouts (trajectories) produced by RL frameworks for training language models. One rollout = one episode = one JSONL line.

openroll_version.description: Semver of the OpenRoll spec this record conforms to. Required.

rollout_id.description: Globally unique id for this rollout. UUIDv4 or content hash recommended.

group_id.description: Optional group identifier. All rollouts that share a baseline (GRPO/RLOO group, or N-best sampling for the same prompt) MUST share a group_id.

parent_rollout_id.description: Optional pointer to a parent rollout when this rollout was produced by a sub-agent.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at start of rollout.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at end of rollout.

lifecycle.description: 'provisional' = subject to change (online rollouts being relabeled); 'final' = immutable.

system_prompts.description: Content-addressed dictionary of system prompts used in this rollout. Keys are sha256 hashes; values are the prompt text. Steps and messages reference prompts by hash to avoid duplication.

tools.description: Tool definitions available to the agent during this rollout.

messages.description: Optional chat-style view of the rollout (system/user/assistant/tool turns). Recommended for SFT/DPO compatibility. May be derived from steps.

steps.description: Ordered list of RL steps. This is the primary, normative trajectory representation. Each step pairs an action with reward and optional training signals (logprobs, values, advantages).

metadata.description: Open extension dictionary. Reverse-DNS keys (e.g. 'org.example.x_field') for vendor extensions; non-namespaced keys are reserved for future spec evolution.

Task.description: What the agent is being asked to do, and how the answer (if any) will be checked.

instruction.description: Verbatim instruction given to the agent (if distinct from description).

Agent.description: Identity of the agent that produced this rollout.

role.description: Agent role for hierarchical agents: 'main', 'planner', 'critic', 'subagent', etc.

Environment.description: The environment the rollout was collected in.

observation_space.description: Optional descriptor of the observation space.

action_space.description: Optional descriptor of the action space.

params.description: Environment configuration parameters used at reset().

Policy.description: Description of a policy (rollout-time or reference). Use 'policy' for the policy that generated this rollout; use 'reference_policy' for the frozen reference used in KL-regularized objectives (PPO, GRPO).

model_id.description: Model identifier ('provider/model-name' or HF repo id).

revision.description: Specific revision/commit/sha of the model weights.

parameters.description: Approximate parameter count, in units of parameters.

SamplingParams.description: Decoding/sampling parameters used to generate actions.

Tokenizer.description: Tokenizer used to produce token_ids and token_logprobs in this rollout. Required if any step contains token-level fields.

ToolDefinition.description: Definition of a tool that was made available to the agent. Mirrors OpenAI tool schema.

ContentPart.description: One part of a multipart message or tool result. Exactly one of text/image_url/audio_url/resource_uri/json_value SHOULD be set, matching 'type'.

image_url.description: URL or data URI of an image.

resource_uri.description: Reference to an external resource (e.g. a file in the bundle).

ToolCall.description: Invocation of a tool by the agent. 'id' MUST be unique within the rollout and is referenced by ToolResult.tool_call_id.

arguments.description: Parsed tool arguments. If the upstream provider only emits a JSON-string, parse it here; preserve the raw string in metadata if needed.

ToolResult.description: Result of a tool invocation. 'tool_call_id' MUST match the corresponding ToolCall.id.

summary.description: Optional short summary of the result for downstream readers.

Message.description: Chat-style view of a single turn. Optional. Provided for SFT/DPO compatibility; the canonical RL representation lives under 'steps'.

reasoning.description: Chain-of-thought / reasoning content separated from final response.

tool_call_id.description: For role='tool' messages, references a ToolCall.id.

step_index.description: Back-reference to the step that produced this message.

Step.description: A single RL step. Combines the agent's action with the environment's reward and optional training signals (logprobs, values, advantages). For LLM rollouts, an action is typically one assistant turn (text + tool calls).

role.description: Origin of this step. 'agent' = action by the policy; 'env'/'tool'/'user' = exogenous step contributing only observation/reward.

observation.description: Environment observation prior to the action. Free-form (string for text envs; dict for structured envs; can reference resource_uri for large blobs).

reward.description: Scalar reward attributed to this step.

reward_components.description: Decomposed reward signals. Keys are component names, values are floats. Sum need not equal 'reward' — agencies may apply weighting.

terminated.description: MDP-terminal: episode ended in a terminal state (no value bootstrap).

truncated.description: Externally cut off (timelimit, budget exhausted) — value SHOULD still bootstrap.

value.description: Critic value V(s) at this step under the rollout policy.

advantage.description: Advantage estimate (e.g. GAE, group-relative) for this step.

return_.description: Monte-Carlo or bootstrapped return at this step.

kl_to_ref.description: KL(rollout policy || reference policy) at this step.

logprob.description: Sum log-prob of the action under the rollout policy. For LLM steps, this is the sum of token log-probs over the generated tokens.

ref_logprob.description: Sum log-prob under the reference policy.

token_ids.description: Action token ids (per the rollout's tokenizer).

prompt_token_ids.description: Prompt/context token ids fed into the policy at this step.

action_mask.description: 1 for tokens generated by the policy, 0 for prompt/tool-output tokens. Same length as token_ids+prompt_token_ids when present.

token_logprobs.description: Per-token log-prob under the rollout policy. Length == len(token_ids).

tools_available.description: Names of tools available at this step (subset of rollout.tools).

info.description: Gymnasium-style free-form info dict (debugging, hidden state, per-component reward decomposition).

Action.description: The agent's action. For LLM rollouts, 'text' carries the generated text. For non-LLM/RL envs, set 'value' (and optionally 'type').

reasoning.description: Chain-of-thought / reasoning emitted alongside the action.

final_reward.description: Episode return (sum of step rewards) or task-level scalar if step rewards are absent.

Judge.description: Metadata for a judge or verifier that produced the reward signal.

model.description: If kind='llm' or 'model', the judge model identifier.

Metrics.description: Aggregate metrics computed over the rollout. May be derived from steps but stored for fast filtering.
